g.text: FlexMAC: why score registration adds ten cycles per image
Illustrative unstalled schedule, not a captured waveform. Command is accepted at cycle 0; pixels occupy cycles 1–64.
Class 0: MAC 65–96, compare 97. Class 9: MAC 362–393, compare 394. Input gaps and result stalls are excluded.
Cycles are not elapsed time: tested periods are 13.59375 ns (baseline) and 11.2890625 ns (score pipeline).
